Emily (Eng): Thanks everyone for the all-hands — slides + recording are up (link in thread). Quick follow-up: can leadership clarify APAC GPU region timeline, and how autoscaler burst behavior will work for Dedicated vs Hosted? Also want to capture action items.
Raj (Product): APAC target we mentioned was 'Q3 pilot' but that's contingent on two things: 1) spare GPU procurement, 2) validation of our private control plane in the region. Working with procurement and infra on both.
Sana (Eng SRE): Autoscaler note — current default policy is conservative: min=0, max burst up to 2x configured pool for 5m, then scale back. That burst is per-pool, not global; it can be gated by quota.
Tim (VP Infrastructure): @Emily good call. Short answers: APAC pilot = late Q3 (not GA). We'll prioritize customers on Dedicated + enterprise pilots first. For Hosted, we'll route from APAC through nearest regional edge until GA.
Sana (Eng SRE): Quick config example (current prod-ish):
```
pool:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 40
  burst_multiplier: 2
  burst_window: 300s
  cooldown: 180s
```
Sana (Eng SRE): Important: burst_multiplier uses available capacity; if the region has no spare GPUs, we fall back to cross-region routing. That fallback is automatic but has a latency tradeoff.
Raj (Product): APAC procurement update: we have a PO in flight for 40 A10G-equivalent GPUs. ETA depends on vendor lead times (2-8 weeks). I'll post PO number once confirmed.
Emily (Eng): Can we get a clear SLA/routing doc for customers so sales/support can be prescriptive? Customers asked about latency guarantees if we route cross-region.
Tim (VP Infrastructure): Yes — action: I'll own a short doc that shows: (a) default routing behavior, (b) Dedicated vs Hosted differences, (c) what triggers cross-region routing. ETA end of next week. @Sana will help with exact cooldowns and metrics.
Maria (CEO): Thanks — prioritize customers flagged by sales for APAC pilot. @Raj triage the list and share the first three pilot customers by EOD Friday.
Sana (Eng SRE): Also adding monitoring signals we want to surface: "burst_initiated", "fallback_cross_region", "avg_tail_latency_ms". We'll hook these into the Console and a dashboard alert for paging thresholds.
deploy-bot: Recording uploaded: https://redwood.slack-recordings/1845127890 :memo:
Emily (Eng): Action items summary: 1) Tim doc on routing/SLAs (ETA next week), 2) Raj share APAC pilot customer list (EOD Fri), 3) Sana dashboard + exact autoscaler knobs (PR by Wed), 4) Procurement to confirm PO ETA. I'll compile and ping execs after updates. :thumbsup:
Tim (VP Infrastructure): I'll post the doc as a short RFC in #eng-infra and link here. If we need to accelerate GA, we should talk tradeoffs (e.g., reduce burst window, trade increased autoscaling costs for lower cross-region routing).
Raj (Product): FYI — sales already flagged two customers that need APAC private deployment. I'll coordinate with @Tim and @Sana offline.
Maria (CEO): Appreciate the concrete plan. If procurement can move faster, we'll prioritize resources to accelerate testing. Keep the exec sync updated. :rocket:
Emily (Eng): Thanks all — closing the thread. I'll update the action-item checklist in the shared doc and ping when PRs/docs land.
file_notes: All-hands follow-up thread focused on capacity, APAC rollout, autoscaler behavior, and assigned action items. Thread style: short Q&A and follow-ups; includes a small config snippet and a bot recording link.
